patch_description: Combines the cost-guided greedy sampling from prior programs with a ruin-and-recreate perturbation loop: repeatedly remove a random segment of 3-5 transactions from the current best schedule and greedily re-insert them at all positions, evaluating real makespan via get_opt_seq_cost. This diversifies restarts while preserving the cost-based selection signal, then finishes with adjacent-swap hill climbing under a 25s time budget per workload.
